content: Dɑfidin bii, Sɑlomɔɔ, wi u sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn sunɔ, win mɔnnɑ.
Mɔnnun ɑrufɑɑni
Mɔn ni sɔɔrɑ tɔnu koo bwisi kɑ yɛ̃ru wɑ kpɑ ɡɑri yi yi tubum sɛ̃ yi nùn yeeri.
Nu koo nùn bwisi ɡee sɔ̃ɔsi kpɑ u ko ye n sɑ̃ɑ dee dee weesu kɑ tɑki sɑriru sɔɔ.
Nu koo lɑɑkɑri sɑriruɡii ko lɑɑkɑriɡii, kpɑ nu ɑluwɑɑsi yɛ̃ru kɑ bwisi kɛ̃.
Niyɑ nu koo mɑɑ bwisiɡiin bwisi sosi, kpɑ nu yɛ̃ruɡii kpɑrɑ
u kɑ mɔnnun tubusiɑnu kɑ bwisiɡibun ɡɑri tubu.
À n kĩ ɑ n bwisi mɔ, ɑ de ɑ ɡinɑ Gusunɔ nɑsiɑ. Domi wi u rɑ bwisi kɑ sɛɛyɑsiɑbu ɑtɑfiiru ko, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ.
Bɑ ɑluwɑɑsibɑ bwisi kɛ̃mɔ
Wunɛ, nɛn bii durɔbu, ɑ wunɛn bɑɑbɑn sɔ̃ɔsiru nɔɔwɔ, kpɑ ɑ ku rɑ wunɛn mɛron ɡere yinɑ.
Yɑ koo de wunɛn dɑɑ yu wɛ̃rɑ nɡe mɛ furɔ burɔ kɑ wurɑ rɑ wɑsi burɑru kue.
Wunɛ, nɛn bii durɔbu, tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ̀ n nun kɔkirimɔ, ɑ ku rɑ wurɑ.
Bɑ̀ n ɡeruɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑ nɑ ɑ kɑ bu dɑ i tɔmbu sɑmbɑ ko i bu sɛ̃suku bɑɑ bɑ̀ kun ɡɑ̃ɑnu kue,
i bu ɡo yɑnde nɡe mɛ ɡɔribun wɑ̃ɑ yeru tɑ rɑ tɔnu mwɛ wɑsiru. I bu mwɑ nɡe wɔru bɔkɔ ɡe ɡɑ tɔnu sɑmbɑ kuɑ u wɔri.
I ko ɑrumɑni bwese bwesekɑ wɑ i dɑm diimɑ i yibiɑ bɛɛn diɑɔ.
A nɑ ɑ kɑ bu mɛnnɑ, kpɑ i bɛɛn mɔru kpuro doke bɔɔ teeru sɔɔ.
Wunɛ, nɛn bii durɔbu, ɑ ku kɑ tɔn ben bweseru swĩinɑ. A ku ben yirɑ du.
Ben nɑɑsu sɑ̃u bu kɑ kɔ̃sɑ ko. Bɑ mɑɑ sɛnde bu kɑ tɔnun yɛm yɑri.
Gunɔ ɡe ɑ yinɑ bɛriɑmmɛ, ɡɑ̀ n nun mɛɛrɑ, kɑmɑ ɑ bɛrimɔ.
Adɑmɑ tɔn be, bɑ tii yinɑ bɛriɑmmɛ, bɑ koo mɑɑ mwɑɑrɑ ye sɔɔ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ n sɑ̃ɑ kɑ bɑɑwure wi u dukiɑn kĩru mɔ. Be bɑ tii ye wɛ̃, berɑ yɑ rɑ ɡo.
A ku bwisi kɛ̃ru yinɑ
Bwisi yi ɡbɑ̃rɑmɔ tɔɔwɔ, yi nɔɔɡiru sue wuun bɑtumɑ sɔɔ.
Yi ɡbɑ̃rɑmɔ swɑɑ kɛɛnɑnɔ yi yin ɡɑri kpɑrɑmɔ mi wiruɡibɑ rɑ mɛnnɛ,
yi mɔ̀, bɛɛ lɑɑkɑri sɑribɑ, sere dommɑ i kĩ i n wɑ̃ɑ bwisi sɑriru sɔɔ. Bɛɛ yɑɑko kowobu, sere dommɑ i ko n nuku dobu mɔ̀ bɛɛn yɑɑko kobu sɔɔ, kpɑ bɛɛ ɡɑri bɑkɑsu i n yɛ̃ru tusɑ.
I ɡɔsirɑmɑ i nɛn ɡerusibu nɔ. Kon bɛɛ nɛn hunde wɛ̃, kpɑ n kɑ bɛɛ nɛn yɛ̃ru bɔnu ko.
Wee, nɑ bɛɛ sokɑ, i ǹ wure. Nɑ bɛɛ nɔmɑ ɡɑ̃ri, ɡoo kun nɛ.
I nɛn bwisi kɛ̃ru kpuro yinɑ, i ǹ mɑɑ nɛn ɡerusibu kĩ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ, bɛɛn wɑhɑlɑ sɔɔ, sɑnɑm mɛ bɛrum bɛɛ mwɑ nɡe ɡuru woo bɔkɔ, mɑ wɑhɑlɑ yɑ seewɑ nɡe woo ɡunɑ yɑ kɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu kɑ tɔ̃yɑ nɑ, nɛn tii kon bɛɛ yɛ̃ɛ kpɑ n bɛɛ yɑɑkoru ko.
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ i ko mɑn soku, ɑdɑmɑ nɑ ǹ bɛɛ wurɑrimɔ. I ko mɑn kɑsu, i ǹ mɑɑ mɑn wɑsi.
Domi i yɛ̃ru tusɑ, i ǹ kĩ i Yinni Gusunɔ nɑsiɑ.
I ǹ nɛn bwisi kɛ̃ru wure, mɑ i nɛn ɡerusibu ɑtɑfiiru kuɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, i ko bɛɛn himbɑ kɑ bɛɛn kookoosun ɑre di i debu.
Lɑɑkɑri sɑribɑn bwisi kɛ̃ɛ yinɑbu koo de bu ɡbi. Gɑri bɑkɑsun biti sɑrirɑ derɑ bɑ kɑm mɔ̀.
Adɑmɑ wi u nɛn ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑki, win bwɛ̃rɑ ko n kpĩ. U ǹ ko n mɑɑ wurure kɔ̃sɑ ɡɑɑn bɛrum sɔ̃.
Bwisi yi rɑ kɔ̃sɑ ɡbɑrewɑ
